Messages.Body:
FYI:

The card list on the White Wolf web site had until this morning
showed incorrect card text for superior Terror Frenzy (showing
the old Sabbat card text for the superior). The web site is now
corrected, and the actual card text is given below. My apologies
for the error.

Terror Frenzy. Combat. Animalism. 1 blood. Sabbat War (R).
Only usable before range is determined on the first round. During this
combat, the opposing minion cannot use maneuvers to maneuver to close
range, cannot use presses to continue combat and cannot use equipment.
(S) Only usable before range is determined. Opposing vampire burns an
additional blood when playing combat cards this combat. A vampire may
play only one Terror Frenzy at superior each combat.

Note: the superior effect doesn't affect the cost of the card, and
doesn't add a new cost. It causes a burn blood effect (so the
opposing vampire would pay the cost, if any, of the combat card he
plays and then burn a blood).
